peripheral.bindHint: Add Sesame to be connected within 1 meter of this {{device}}:
peripheral.sleeping: Once you leave the settings page, restart after updating SesameOS, or disconnect the Bluetooth connection with your Android phone, the {{device}} will automatically switch to power-saving mode. If you would update SesameOS or add a new Sesame, reset the {{device}} by pressing and holding the reset button with a thin stick for about 5 seconds until the LED turns off. Then, register again from the ⊕ button.
peripheral.hint_card:
Connect  {{device}} with Bluetooth, tap ⊕, and place your NFC card on {{device}} to add the NFC card, tap X when finished.

Android phones or watches usually have multiple built-in NFC cards, and the NFC card number you add each time may vary. It is recommended that you add all built-in IC cards to reduce the likelihood of misjudgment.
peripheral.hint_passcode: Connect {{device}} with Bluetooth, tap ⊕, enter the passcode and press the lock or unlock button to add the passcode, tap X when finished.
peripheral.hint_face: Connect {{device}} with Bluetooth, tap ⊕. Show your Face then tap X. Register after mounting for supreme recognition rates.
peripheral.hint_palm: Connect {{device}} with Bluetooth, tap ⊕. Show Palm Veins then tap X. Register after mounting for supreme recognition rates.
peripheral.hint_fingerprint:
Connect {{device}} with Bluetooth, tap ⊕, and place your finger on {{device}} to add a fingerprint, tap X when finished.

Also, by registering the same finger at different angles, the recognition rate can greatly improve👍
peripheral.wifiBindHint: Add Sesame to be connected within 5 meters of this WiFi Module:
peripheral.radarDescription:
・This is the Radar wake-up detection range.
・Over 10 visits/day: shorten range(even to 0cm) to save power !
・10 or fewer visits/day: extend to max range for the best experience.
・Even at minimum range, pressing the Unlock Button/Side Button triggers face or palm-vein recognition, balancing power saving with a supreme user experience.
・Do not mix batteries of different brands, ages, or model types. 
・Use all the batteries, not just 2. More batteries, better load sharing, more voltage stability, longer battery life.

lockExtras.autoHint:
1. Set the red circle around your Sesame. Leaving the circle arms one Auto Unlock. When you return, the door unlocks only after this phone connects to the registered Sesame over nearby Bluetooth.
2. If location detection is unstable, make the red circle larger. You can adjust Sesame\'s location by tapping the map.
3. Restart your smartphone if Auto Unlock is not functional.
